verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUWULIRE mmwe-abantu be
Abamukiriza;
Mubunye ebigambo bye
Kristo wa Katonda.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mubuulire wonna wonna,
Mu mawanga gonna;
Banabbi ye gwe baalanga
Ye musana gw'ensi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Katonda-ow'olubeerera,
Eyeefuula omuntu,
Eyatwala omubiri,
Ye Katonda ddala.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Katonda-ava mu Kitaffe
Asinzibwa bonna,
Eyatuwonya mu kufa
N'atufuula abaana.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Fenna abamukkiriza
Atuwe-omwoyo gwe;
Bwe tuba tataataagana,
Ye atulumgamya
